description: Output of the fix role: a report on each Important finding it was given. Claims only - the next review decides what is actually resolved.

addressed.description: Findings you changed code for. Every id here must appear in the findings you were given.

how.description: The change you made: files touched and why that removes the defect. Recorded as a claim, not as proof.

not_addressed.description: Findings you did not change code for. Empty array when you addressed all of them.

why.description: Why you left it: the fix is out of the allowed edit scope, the finding looks wrong, or the fix needs a decision a human must make.
